thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Automated detector -> elevated 5xx + client timeouts observed on /v1/generate. p95 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.8s, p99 from ~900ms to ~6.2s. Paging SRE rotation now. (alerts/timeout-regression)
chen: acknowledged; I'm seeing a pattern: gateway returning 502/504 and upstream connection timeouts to model-proxy. Rolling window of errors started ~+30s after the deploy window. link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/gateway
alex: +1 on timing. Which deploy rolled at ~1763001150? I think we pushed a gateway deadline propagation change (propagate-client-deadline=true) in release/2026-03-17-gw.
maria: If client deadlines are being forwarded, short client keepalives could be causing premature upstream cancels -> cascade. Can someone check gateway config and envoy filters? I can do a quick grep.
chen: grabbing logs. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T15:20:42.123Z gateway INFO forward request /v1/generate id=xyz deadline_ms=5000
2026-03-17T15:20:47.130Z proxy WARN upstream connect timeout id=xyz
2026-03-17T15:20:47.131Z gateway ERROR response 504 id=xyz
```
alex: that's consistent. The new flag causes deadlines to be propagated to the backend which then cancels earlier; backend has blocking warmup on some paths -> p99 blowout. We should roll back the gateway config or revert the small deploy. Recommend rollback gateway config to previous value and temporarily disable deadline propagation.
kevin: I'm on pager. Initiating rollback of release/2026-03-17-gw now. Running:
```
# rollback to previous stable
rdeploy rollback --service gateway --ref release/2026-03-10-gw
# fallback if k8s
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/gateway --to-revision=41
```
kevin: rollback started, patch applied to config; reverting propagate-client-deadline -> false. Monitoring.
oncall-bot: Incident severity set to SEV-2 by kevin. Notifying customers if SLO impact persists > 30m.
chen: post-rollback telemetry shows error rate dropping within one minute. p99 back to ~900ms, p95 ~260ms. Still watching KV cache warmups in a few nodes. Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/gateway?from=-5m
maria: Can we add a short circuit in the proxy to ignore client deadline when backend warmup is in-flight? Also add a rollout guard in CI to require canary soak for deadline flags.
product-jamie: Are customer-facing errors observed? Any correlated 500s from accounts hitting large requests? Need to assess comms. If impact contained to internal retries, we can hold on external comms.
alex: From logs only internal retries and increased 504s for long-running requests. Customer impact minimal so far but SLO alerting was triggered. Recommend postmortem + follow-up action items: revert flag, add canary gating, add synthetic tests for deadline propagation.
kevin: Confirmed rollback completed at 1763001398. Error volume returning to baseline. I'll hand back to oncall for follow-up and postmortem owner assignment.
oncall-bot: Incident marked resolved (mitigated) at 1763001420. Please file a postmortem and link here. :white_check_mark:
